name: Toosma
description: Toosma was the fourth and largest planet orbiting the star Tyrius in the Tyrius system. Located in the Savareen sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a yellow-orange gas giant and had a total of 18 moons.
lead_paragraphs: Toosma was the fourth and largest planet orbiting the star Tyrius in the Tyrius system. Located in the Savareen sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a yellow-orange gas giant and had a total of 18 moons.
The moons of the planet were occasionally mined by Rodian arms manufacturers.
